summary: Erbil International Airport (EBL) is the primary aviation gateway to the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, serving the capital city of Erbil and the surrounding governorate. The airport underwent a major modernization and expansion in the late 2000s and early 2010s, transforming it into one of the most modern facilities in Iraq with a capacity for several million passengers annually. It functions as a key hub connecting northern Iraq with the Middle East, Europe, and beyond, supporting both business travel linked to the region's oil industry and tourism to the historic citadel of Erbil.
faqs:
Q: How far is Erbil International Airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 7-10 kilometers northwest of central Erbil, typically a 15-20 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Are there direct international flights from Erbil?
A: Yes, the airport offers direct connections to many regional and international destinations including Istanbul, Dubai, Doha, Amman, and several European cities.

Q: Is the airport considered safe for travel?
A: Erbil International Airport is generally considered safe and operates under the administration of the Kurdistan Regional Government, with modern security procedures in place.

Q: Does the airport have currency exchange and ATMs?
A: Yes, there are ATMs and currency exchange services available in the terminal, though it is advisable to carry some Iraqi dinar or US dollars in cash as a backup.
transport_tips: Taxis are the most common way to reach the city center and are readily available outside the terminal, with the journey typically costing a fixed reasonable fare. Ride-hailing apps also operate in Erbil and can be arranged at the airport. Many hotels in Erbil offer airport pickup services, which is worth arranging in advance for added convenience, especially for first-time visitors.
local_tip: If you have a layover or extra time, ask your driver to take a short detour past Erbil Citadel, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that is one of the oldest continuously inhabited places on Earth and visible from much of the city.
